name: people-listed-as-ldap-entries
description: GET / searches ou=people (one level, filter (objectClass=*)) and returns the string form of the aggregated LDAPEntry list: the three people from ldap.ldif with relative DNs, binary userPassword values base64-encoded. Body text is exactly the README sample; entry and attribute order is compared order-insensitively (README 'Behavioural deltas'). The Mule IT asserts the three dn lines are present.

source.reference: extracting-data-from-LDAP-directory/README.md step 15 (sample output) with src/main/resources/ldap.ldif and src/main/app/ldap.xml (ldap:search baseDn="ou=people" filter="(objectClass=*)", object-to-string); dn lines also asserted in src/test/java/org/mule/examples/ExtractingDataFromLdapDirectoryIT.java#connectAndExtract
